relations.rationale: Ivo and Rosa being on different teams doesn't determine whether Leo and Rosa are on different teams.
Ivo and Rosa being on different teams implies at least two teams exist, mildly supporting the existence of multiple teams including possibly three.
Height comparison has no bearing on previous season standings.
Rosa's height relative to Kai has no bearing on when the race began.
Rosa's height compared to Kai has no bearing on Ben watching riders with a stopwatch.
Adjusting a helmet strap and joking with Ben are both plausible simultaneous actions but neither confirms or denies the other.
Rosa adjusting her helmet strap has no bearing on the crowd's cheers during the race.
Rosa joking with Ben about wind has no bearing on Kai's prior season ranking.
Rosa joking with Ben about chilly wind has no bearing on when the race began.
Rosa joking with Ben doesn't affect whether Ben is watching riders with a stopwatch.
Rosa joking with Ben about wind has no bearing on her holding a steady pace in the race, and these seem to occur at different times (before vs during race).
Leo and Rosa being on different teams has no bearing on Kai greeting Leo warmly.
Leo and Rosa being on different teams implies at least two teams, mildly supporting the existence of three teams.
Team assignments have no bearing on when the race began.
Leo and Rosa being on different teams has no bearing on Ben watching with a stopwatch.
Team assignments have no bearing on the crowd's reaction at the finish line.
Kai's past ranking has no direct bearing on the crowd cheering during the race.
Kai's ranking in prior standings has no bearing on Ben's age relative to Ivo.
Kai greeting Leo near refreshments has no bearing on the crowd's cheers during the race.
Kai greeting Leo warmly before the race has no bearing on the leaders' position at midday.
